title: Coefficient composition and identity of the concrete comparisons
statement: Fix normalized scalar/tensor models and their representative-normalized choices [def-sp-open-scalar-tensor-data], and the concrete input and support comparisons [def-sf-concrete-projection-reduction-data]. For arbitrary coefficient maps A→B→C, the scalar tensor comparison satisfies its composition equation with the canonical scalar associator, and its identity equation with the scalar unitor. The support comparison satisfies the same composition and identity equations for every compactification and every unbounded input. For finite coefficient rings and an arbitrary scheme morphism f, the input comparison for K tensor Lf*L likewise satisfies composition and identity, with the scalar associator on K and its pullback on L. These are the six displayed Lean equations tensor_comp, tensor_id, support_comp, support_id, input_comp and input_id. No separatedness of structure morphisms or invertibility of a projection is assumed.

proof.text: The normalized tensor comparison respects coefficient composition and identities by its flat K-flat representative equations and descent.

Transport the canonical compact-support comparison cocycle and identity by unique scalar adjunction isomorphisms. Composite adjunction unit equations identify the scalar compositors. Naturality cancels the intermediate presentation isomorphisms.
Expand the tensor/pullback input comparison. Naturality of the scalar tensor comparison, coefficient coherence of lambda, and the tensor equations give the input composition and identity equations.

lean.statement:
theorem input_id (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : proEtaleDerivedCategory X A) (L : proEtaleDerivedCategory Y A) :
    (inputComparison m choices (RingHom.id A) f K L).hom ≫
      (tensor m A X).map (Prod.mkHom ((scalarId m A X).hom.app K)
        ((constantPullback (A := A) f).map ((scalarId m A Y).hom.app L))) =
      (scalarId m A X).hom.app (input m A f K L)
